_readme: Add your API keys below. Gemini keys are used for OCR. Add as many as you have — they rotate automatically when one hits its quota.

gemini._info: Google Gemini API keys — get them at https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey

openai._info: OpenAI API keys — get them at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

aimlapi._info: AI/ML API keys — get them at https://aimlapi.com

groq._info: Groq API keys — get them at https://console.groq.com/keys

anthropic._info: Anthropic (Claude) API keys — get them at https://console.anthropic.com

cohere._info: Cohere API keys — get them at https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys
